text: Work Pay Note 是面向 DSH Web 界面的可拖动收入便笺，通过 shell.overlay 插槽显示今日收入、本月累计和月度目标。它按月薪、工作日及上下班和午休时间计算进度，并允许调整背景图片或视频、亮度、位置及收起状态。适合希望在工作时快速查看估算收入的用户；设置保存在浏览器本地，背景媒体经 DSH 本机路由保存，无需外部账号或 API 密钥。

Work Pay Note adds a draggable earnings note to the DSH Web UI. It estimates daily and monthly earnings from pay and work hours, with configurable lunch breaks. Users can personalize its background and collapse or move it. Settings are stored locally; no API key is required.
想在 DSH 页面上随时看到今天大约赚了多少钱
I want a small DSH widget that estimates my earnings as the workday progresses.
Work Pay Note 的「收入进度」功能：根据月薪、当月工作日、上下班时间和午休时段估算今日及本月收入，并显示目标进度。用户在便笺设置中填写薪资与排班，界面随时间更新。
Work Pay Note 的「背景媒体与便笺布局」功能：用户可从设置选择图片或视频作为背景并调节亮度，也可拖动便笺、收起为小条再展开；背景媒体由插件主机路由读写。

dsh-work-pay-note README · Work Pay Note · 上班赚钱：A draggable sticky note for **DeepSeek Harness** that counts **today's** and **this month's** earnings in real time from your work schedule. Drop it anywhere on the Web UI, glance at it during the day, collapse it when you do not need it.

一款挂在 DeepSeek Harness 界面上的「上班赚钱」提示贴：按你的上下班时间实时计算今天和本月赚到的金额，可拖动、可收起。
section: Work Pay Note · 上班赚钱

text:
dsh-work-pay-note README · Features · 功能：- **Live today's pay** — accrues per second inside your working hours, pauses over lunch, stops at the end of the day.
- **Month-to-date** — prorated by the weekdays of the current month (Monday–Friday), with the month target and a progress bar.
- **Today's progress ring** — a quick read of how much of the workday is done.
- **Schedule aware** — start/end time and lunch break are configurable; the card shows the schedule and the time left until off work.
- **Background media** — an optional photo, GIF/APNG/animated WebP, or a short MP4/WebM loop, with a brightness slider. Bright media switches the card to a light veil with dark text; dark media keeps cream text. Without a background the card keeps its orange gradient.
- **Stays out of the way** — drag it by the header, collapse it to a small pill, reopen with one click.
- **Local only** — no network calls beyond the local background route; settings never leave the machine.

dsh-work-pay-note README · Install · 安装：Install it from the DeepSeek Harness plugin market (Plugins → Discover) once listed.

Or point `dsh` at this repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/meijieYUan/dsh-work-pay-note
```

Then restart the app (or reload the Web UI). The card appears in the bottom-right corner.

No build step and no runtime dependencies: the package ships plain ESM host code and a plain browser module.

dsh-work-pay-note README · Use · 使用：1. Click the sliders icon on the card and set your monthly pay, start/end time and lunch break.
2. Optionally pick a background under **Background**, and tune its brightness.
3. Drag the card by its header; the chevron collapses it to a pill.

dsh-work-pay-note README · Background storage · 背景图片存放：The background file lives in the plugin's own `assets/` folder (`background.jpg` / `.png` / `.gif` / `.mp4` / `.webm` …). Picking a file in settings copies it there; you can also drop a file in by hand.

Because it lives inside the plugin folder, **updating or reinstalling the plugin replaces that folder**, so an uploaded background may need to be picked again afterwards.
section: Background storage · 背景图片存放

text:
dsh-work-pay-note README · How the numbers work · 计算方式：- Daily pay = monthly pay ÷ number of weekdays in the current month.
- Today's pay = worked minutes today × daily pay ÷ scheduled working minutes, lunch excluded.
- Month-to-date = completed weekdays × daily pay + today's pay.
- Holidays are not modelled; adjust the schedule if a day differs.
section: How the numbers work · 计算方式
